name: create_grid
description: Create a rectangular grid system from bay spacings (mm) in two directions: x_spacings places grids along X (vertical lines), y_spacings places grids along Y (horizontal lines); N spacings make N+1 grids. Naming per direction is inferred from the start label (letter = A,B..Z,AA; digits = 1,2,3); duplicates get a numeric suffix. Lines extend extension_mm past the outermost grids. Returns created grid ids, names and positions in mm.

params.name: x_spacings
params.description: Bay widths in mm along the X axis between consecutive vertical grids, e.g. [6000, 6000, 8000] makes 4 grids. Empty list makes a single grid.

params.name: y_spacings
params.description: Bay widths in mm along the Y axis between consecutive horizontal grids. Empty list makes a single grid.

params.name: x_start_label
params.description: Label of the first vertical grid. A letter gives alphabetic naming (A, B, ... Z, AA); digits give numeric naming.

params.name: y_start_label
params.description: Label of the first horizontal grid. Digits give numeric naming (1, 2, 3); a letter gives alphabetic.

params.name: origin_x_mm
params.description: X position of the first vertical grid in mm (default 0).

params.name: origin_y_mm
params.description: Y position of the first horizontal grid in mm (default 0).

params.name: extension_mm
params.description: How far grid lines extend beyond the outermost crossing grids, in mm (default 2000).
